preview.description: Digitally validated geometry and printer-bed envelopes for a split vibrotactile headrest enclosure. Physical printing, fit, load, vibration, temperature, and human-use suitability remain unverified.

images.alt: Assembled isometric CAD view of the full-size split vibrotactile headrest enclosure
images.caption: Assembled 300 × 140 mm enclosure with the off-centre split visible

images.alt: Exploded CAD view of the headrest shell, end cap, service panel, actuator spine, and internal reference parts
images.caption: Engineering assembly separated to show the retained split construction

images.alt: Bottom CAD view of the headrest with the service panel removed and actuator envelope visible
images.caption: Underside cavity with the structural panel removed

images.alt: Exploded CAD detail showing the split shell, alignment pin, service panel, actuator, and sensor envelope
images.caption: Split, pin, panel, actuator, and sensor relationships

images.alt: Open isometric CAD view showing the actuator envelope mounted beneath the internal structural spine
images.caption: Internal actuator-spine layout crossing the shell seam
